title: Glowing paint palette
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5b3a1a' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5b3a1a' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id='blur'>
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation='2.5'/>
    </filter>
  </defs>
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='42' fill='url(#glow)' filter='url(#blur)' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- Palette body -->
  <path d='M50 22 C72 22 86 38 86 56 C86 72 74 82 60 82 C52 82 48 78 46 74 C44 70 40 68 36 70 C32 72 26 74 22 70 C18 66 14 58 14 50 C14 34 30 22 50 22 Z' fill='#d48a3c' stroke='#f0b060' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Palette inner rim highlight -->
  <path d='M50 28 C68 28 80 42 80 56 C80 68 70 76 60 76 C54 76 50 73 48 69 C45 64 40 62 36 64 C32 66 28 66 24 63 C20 60 19 54 19 49 C19 37 33 28 50 28 Z' fill='#e8a050' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- Thumb hole -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='56' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#3a2210' stroke='#f0b060' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='56' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#5b3a1a'/>
  <!-- Paint blobs -->
  <!-- Red -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='36' r='6' fill='#ff3b3b'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='36' r='3' fill='#ff6b6b' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Blue -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='30' r='6' fill='#3b7bff'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='30' r='3' fill='#6b9bff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Yellow -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='36' r='6' fill='#ffe23b'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='36' r='3' fill='#fff06b' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Green -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='50' r='6' fill='#3bff6b'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='50' r='3' fill='#6bff9b' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Purple -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='64' r='6' fill='#b43bff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='64' r='3' fill='#c96bff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Orange -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='74' r='5.5' fill='#ff8c2b'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='74' r='2.5' fill='#ffb06b' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- White/cream -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='72' r='5' fill='#f0f0f0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='72' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Tiny sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe23b'>
    <path d='M44 44 l1.5 3 3 1.5 -3 1.5 -1.5 3 -1.5 -3 -3 -1.5 3 -1.5z'/>
    <path d='M62 46 l1 2 2 1 -2 1 -1 2 -1 -2 -2 -1 2 -1z'/>
    <path d='M34 52 l1 2 2 1 -2 1 -1 2 -1 -2 -2 -1 2 -1z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Paintbrush -->
  <g transform='rotate(-25, 72, 80)'>
    <rect x='69' y='66' width='6' height='22' rx='1' fill='#c4783a'/>
    <rect x='69' y='66' width='6' height='22' rx='1' fill='#e8a050' opacity='0.3'/>
    <!-- Metal ferrule -->
    <rect x='68.5' y='84' width='7' height='4' rx='0.5' fill='#a0a0a0'/>
    <rect x='68.5' y='84' width='7' height='1.5' fill='#c0c0c0' opacity='0.5'/>
    <!-- Bristles / paint -->
    <path d='M69 88 Q72 96 75 88 Z' fill='#ff3b3b'/>
    <path d='M70 88 Q72 94 74 88 Z' fill='#ff6b6b' opacity='0.6'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Doot's glow sparkle highlights -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='42' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='66' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
